name: Cajeta Crepes
description: Delicate crepes folded around a generous pour of cajeta—a rich Mexican goat-milk caramel—and topped with pecans.
ingredients: a handful of fresh epazote, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with olive oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the bolillo rolls and dried oregano until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the toasted pumpkin seeds with the water until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 15 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Bring your toasted pumpkin seeds to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
